messages:
alice: okay tiny office drama: found a printed note on my salad that read like an LLM romance novel. who let LunchMuse run unsupervised? 😂

alice: ```
Oh humble salad, cradle of greens,
Forgotten by hands that sang of jeans.
Return, beloved, ere dressing grows cold—
Lest the break room weeps and the croutons fold.

— LunchMuse v0.7 (trained on greeting cards & dev logs)
```

brian: omg poetic cruelty. also it called my kale "beloved" which is a lot to process at 2pm

chloe: contest opportunity: best 'utility-first' rewrite wins a $5 snack card. rules: keep it under 20 words, zero pathos.

alice: example entry: "This item appears unclaimed. Please retrieve within 48h to avoid composting." — 15 words, cold and effective.

office-bot: persona toggle: `utility-first` set by @chloe. Reminder scheduled: kitchen cleanup tomorrow 10:00am. :calendar:

brian: also low-key privacy ask: can bots stop inventing emotions for food? makes lunchroom awkward when guests visit

chloe: agreed. new policy: bot notes must include '(for office fun only)' and avoid emotion words.

culture: approving $5 snack card for the contest winner. tag entries with #lunchlessons by EOD. :tada:

alice: submitting my cold-note remake now. may the most pragmatic prompt win.
